title: Choose the photo source
note: Start with Phone or Computer on the existing toolbar.

title: Choose the upload flow
note: Single item and multiple items stay in the existing chooser. Photos for this local demo are supplied by fixtures.

title: Add batch photos from phone or computer
note: The existing upload step offers a QR code, file selection, folder selection and drag-and-drop. This capture precedes receiving photos.

title: Receive photos for a batch
note: Four pictured demo files have arrived. The organizer is the real extension UI.

title: Select photos for the first item
note: Two selected sweater photos make one listing.

title: First item grouped
note: The first group stays visible and the two remaining photos can form the second item.

title: Both items grouped
note: All four photos belong to two listings. Generation has not started.

title: First listing opens immediately
note: Actual Chromium focus moved before the controlled AI response was released. The title is still empty and preparation is visible.

title: First listing ready
note: Photos and generated text are present, fields are editable, and one status banner contains navigation controls.

title: Second listing opens while preparing
note: No extra Next or Start click. The second actual tab becomes active before its controlled generation completes.

title: Both listings ready
note: The second tab stays active. Two controlled generation requests completed, one per item, with no extra Continue click.

title: Batch summary with review links
note: Two listings are ready. Review links reopen the existing listing tabs.

title: Review and edit the prepared listing
note: The original listing tab reopens. A real input edit persists while both listings remain ready. Nothing is published.

title: Single item from computer
note: Start with the existing AutoLister toolbar. The surrounding listing page is a simplified local fixture.

title: Two photos selected
note: Actual browser file selection and real multipart requests were used. Temporary storage and the host photo acknowledgement are controlled.

title: Generation in progress
note: The real extension submitted one request. The response is held locally so the pending state can be reviewed.

title: Generated title and description
note: Title and description are filled. Generate returns to its usable state after the normal brief success indication.

title: Review and edit
note: A seller can edit the generated description. No batch controls are added. Nothing is published.

title: Single-item phone handoff
note: Scan the QR code to add photos. This shows the real extension UI; transport is controlled for this walkthrough.

title: Photos received from the controlled phone session
note: Two photos are ready. This is not proof of an actual handset upload or transport recovery.

title: Generate from the phone modal
note: The extension injects the photos and sends one generation request. The controlled response is held.

title: Single item prepared
note: The phone modal closes, the two photos remain, and text is filled into the existing fields.

title: Add several items
note: The existing compact batch entry screen. No new web app navigation or layout was introduced.

title: Three photos ready to group
note: Real image preparation and browser storage. Select the photos belonging to each item.

title: Select photos of one item
note: Two selected photos are grouped into one item through Create item. The third photo becomes a separate item.

title: Two grouped items ready
note: All three photos are assigned to two items. The seller explicitly starts generation once for the batch.

title: Batch generation in progress
note: The first grouped item is generating. The controlled model response is held; no paid generation is called.

title: Both items ready to copy
note: The existing sequential queue finished both items without another Start or Continue click.

title: All prepared drafts in the library
note: The earlier single item and both new batch items remain saved locally.

title: Open and copy a batch draft
note: Each prepared draft opens in the same compact editor. The actual browser clipboard contains this draft description.

title: Desktop layout remains compact
note: The existing web app at 1440 px after image loading and layout paint. Cover and thumbnail reference the same selected-item blob. No product UI files were changed.

title: First-use listing style
note: Current compact web app at 390 px. A newly created fixture account sees the existing first-use style screen.

title: First item opens after style setup
note: Use this style opens a new item directly, so the seller can add photos immediately.

title: One item with two photos
note: Actual browser file selection, image preparation and browser storage. Generation remains an explicit action.

title: Generation in progress
note: Real web UI and upload requests, with storage and AI services controlled. The model response is held for inspection.

title: Generated item ready
note: Generated text is editable in the compact existing editor. These outputs come from the test fixture, not a paid model.

title: Review, edit and copy
note: A real edit is saved in browser storage. Copy title writes the reviewed title to the real browser clipboard.

title: Draft saved in this browser
note: The prepared item appears in the existing draft library. Browser-local storage is not cloud synchronization.

title: Reload retains edits and both photos
note: After a real page reload, the same local draft, reviewed title and two photos reopen. No extra generation was requested.

title: Editing works offline
note: Chromium network is actually offline. The title edit saves locally. This does not test upload or generation recovery.
